fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: The Ḥukm belongs to Allah alone
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained concerning Allah’s statement ‘The Ḥukm belongs to Allah alone’ that command, decision, and disposal belong to Him alone.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The Ḥukm is part of Tawḥīd. No human being may set himself above Allah’s right in legislation, decision, and obedience, or replace it.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm, Tafsīr zu Sūrah Yūsuf 12:40.
